text.text_excerpt: These cookies are 10/10!!! I order them all the time and they are always cooked to perfection and ALWAYS arrive warm. My favorite is the caramel pecan chocolate chunk! The caramel and the chocolate literally melt into your mouth. I have yet to go to the actual store front but I can rate off of delivery alone based on the quality. They are pretty pricey but it's honestly worth it. Better than insomnia and tiffs treats!

Writing this while still eating the still warm cookies. I ordered 4 assorted flavors: white chocolate macadamia nut, triple chocolate, chocolate chip, and sugar cookie. While all the flavors are absolutely sinfully delicious, that sugar cookie is the shining star. It's a testament to the quality of their product. The simplest offering is just too perfect. Buttery and soft and warm and amazing. And it was ready well before the estimated time. Brought out by a nice young man. Thank you for this experience!!

I purchase the four pack and selected the Oatmeal Deluxe, Macadamia Nut, Pecan Chocolate Chip, and Pecan Chocolate Chip with Caramel. My absolute favorite was the Oatmeal Deluxe. It is a perfectly baked oatmeal cookie with raisins, chocolate chips, and walnuts. This is the exact cookie I have been trying to get my mother to make me for months. The cookie was perfect in every since of the word. My second favorite was the chocolate chip pecan cookie, I just love nut in my cookies. The chocolate chip pecan with caramel was a bit salty, I will just stick with the regular chocolate chip pecan cookies. Lastly, I didn't really care for the macadamia nut's taste. Overall I will return to support ...
